$comment: Editorial preference store (see docs/03-data-model.md section 6). Seeded with the editor's first explicit instructions; inferred patterns are added by the learning system only after repeated observation.

explicit.instruction: For commercial subjects with flat/wooden delivery, 'best read' means the most energetic, fluid take of each script line - not the cleanest or most complete take. The edit's job is to manufacture excitement (music and B-roll will carry it), so prioritize pace, momentum, and life in the voice; assemble line-by-line from the best take of each line across ALL clips rather than favoring one full take.
explicit.context: Noemi :30 - subject is very wooden; editor must make her sound exciting with inspiring music and b-roll

explicit.instruction: The authoritative script for a commercial is whatever the subject actually read on camera (the prompter copy), reconstructed from transcripts - not the draft script document.
